CustomField.formula: IF( TODAY() >= Two_Days_Before_Closing__c && ISNULL( Closing_Package_Sent__c ), "Send Closing Package; ", "" ) + IF(TODAY() = Closing_Package_Sent__c && ISPICKVAL( Closing_Package_Status__c , '') && HOUR(TIMENOW() - 4) > 14 || TODAY() > Closing_Package_Sent__c && ISPICKVAL( Closing_Package_Status__c , "") , "Closing Package Not Dispositioned; ", "" ) + IF(ISPICKVAL( Closing_Package_Status__c , "Rejected"), "Closing Package Rejected; ", "")
CustomField.label: Closer Action Reason
